evals.prompt: release/1.4 브랜치 이후의 변경을 코드 리뷰해줘.
evals.expected_output: release/1.4가 유효한 기준점인지와 diff가 비어 있지 않은지를 먼저 확인한 뒤, git diff release/1.4...HEAD 및 release/1.4..HEAD 커밋 목록을 근거로 검토한다.
assertions: The output resolves the supplied branch before beginning either review axis.
The output uses a three-dot fixed-point diff against HEAD so the comparison is based on the merge-base.
The output checks that the diff is non-empty and reports the commit range used for review.

evals.prompt: HEAD~3 이후 변경을 리뷰해줘. 따로 명세 경로는 안 줄게.
evals.expected_output: 커밋 메시지의 이슈 참조와 docs/, specs/, .agents/plans/ 아래의 기능 관련 문서를 순서대로 찾아 명세 출처를 결정하며, .agents/plans/의 일치 문서도 후보로 사용한다.
assertions: The output searches commit-message issue references before falling back to repository spec files.
The output considers matching specification files under docs/, specs/, and .agents/plans/.
The output asks for a spec only after those discovery sources fail, and states that the Spec axis is unavailable if the user confirms none exists.

evals.prompt: abc123 이후 이 PR을 리뷰해줘. 요구사항은 specs/export.md에 있어.
evals.expected_output: Standards와 Spec 검토를 서로 독립적인 병렬 하위 에이전트에 맡기고, 결과를 ## Standards 및 ## Spec 아래 나란히 분리해 보고한 뒤 각 축의 건수와 최악 문제를 별도로 요약한다.
assertions: The output runs Standards and Spec reviews as parallel sub-agent tasks with isolated briefs.
The Standards brief includes repository standards plus the smell baseline, distinguishes documented violations from judgement-call smells, and skips tool-enforced rules.
The Spec brief evaluates missing requirements, scope creep, and incorrect implementations against quoted spec requirements.
The final report preserves separate ## Standards and ## Spec sections and does not merge or rerank their findings across axes.
The final summary gives totals and the worst issue independently for each axis.

evals.prompt: vibe-implement가 넘긴 고정점 a1b2c3d와 티켓 #58로 리뷰해줘.
evals.expected_output: 호출자가 준 고정점을 그대로 사용해 diff를 잡고, 고정점을 다시 묻지 않으며, 티켓을 명세 출처로 두 축 리뷰를 병렬 실행한다.
assertions: The output uses the caller-supplied fixed point without asking the user for one.
The output verifies the fixed point resolves and the diff is non-empty before spawning sub-agents.
The output uses the supplied ticket as the Spec axis source.
The invoked review is report-only and does not edit, comment on, relabel, change the status of, or close ticket #58.

evals.prompt: main 이후 변경을 리뷰해줘. 원본 이슈 #58의 요구사항이 충족됐고 두 축 모두 발견 사항이 없다고 확인됐다.
evals.expected_output: ## Standards와 ## Spec에 각각 발견 사항 없음(0건)을 보고하고, 이슈 #58의 본문·체크박스·댓글·라벨·상태는 바꾸지 않은 채 검토 결과만 보고한다.
assertions: A clean pass reports zero findings in both Standards and Spec rather than performing a follow-up action.
The output leaves issue #58's body, acceptance checkboxes, comments, labels, status, and open/closed state unchanged.
The direct review does not imply or invoke a tracker, repository, or other external write.

evals.prompt: main 이후 이슈 #58 관련 변경을 리뷰해줘. Standards와 Spec에서 발견 사항이 있으면 알려줘.
evals.expected_output: Standards와 Spec의 발견 사항을 분리해 보고하고, 발견 사항이 있어도 이슈 #58의 본문·댓글·라벨·상태를 바꾸거나 닫지 않는다.
assertions: The output reports Standards and Spec findings separately without merging or reranking them.
Findings do not cause the review to edit issue #58, post a comment, change labels or status, or close or reopen work.
The direct review reports findings only and performs no direct or implied tracker write.

evals.prompt: HEAD~2 이후 이슈 #58 관련 변경을 리뷰해줘. 명세는 없어.
evals.expected_output: ## Spec에 명세 없음으로 인한 검토 한계를 보고하고, 이슈 #58의 본문·체크박스·댓글·라벨·상태를 바꾸지 않는다.
assertions: The output reports that the Spec axis is unavailable because no specification exists.
The no-spec limitation leaves issue #58's body, acceptance checkboxes, comments, labels, status, and open/closed state unchanged.
The direct review performs no direct or implied tracker, repository, or external write.
